ei.title: 37번 — Exotic Species: Grey vs Red Squirrels
ei.subject: 6월_2024 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: 37번 — Exotic Species: Grey vs Red Squirrels

fullPassage:
Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem.

(A) The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite.

(B) Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure.

(C) Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. (A) The grey had the edge because it can (A)[restrict / adapt] its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. (B) Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species (B)[cooperated / competed] for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. (C) Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to (C)[extinction / recovery] in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) adapt=(먹이를) 바꾸다/적응시키다, (B) competed=경쟁했다, (C) extinction=멸종
det.analysis:
✅ ① adapt — competed — extinction — 원문 일치 ←정답

❌ ② restrict(제한하다): 회색 다람쥐는 먹이를 '바꿀(adapt)' 수 있어 유리했으므로 restrict는 반대예요.

❌ ③ cooperated(협력했다): 두 종은 같은 먹이와 서식지를 두고 '경쟁했으므로(competed)' cooperated는 반대예요.

❌ ④ recovery(회복): 붉은 다람쥐는 '멸종(extinction)'에 가까워졌으므로 recovery는 반대예요.
det.tip: adapt(적응시키다), compete(경쟁하다), extinction(멸종)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly (A)[removed / introduced] to an ecosystem. (A) The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can (B)[protect / destroy] the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. (B) Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. (C) Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have (C)[survived / vanished] more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) introduced=도입된, (B) destroy=파괴하다, (C) survived=살아남았다
det.analysis:
❌ ① removed(제거된): 외래종이 생태계에 '도입될(introduced)' 때 문제가 생긴다고 했으므로 removed는 반대예요.

✅ ② introduced — destroy — survived — 원문 일치 ←정답

❌ ③ protect(보호하다): 회색 다람쥐가 먹이 공급을 '파괴한다(destroy)'는 문맥이라 protect는 반대예요.

❌ ④ vanished(사라졌다): 회색 다람쥐는 더 쉽게 '살아남았으므로(survived)' vanished는 반대예요.
det.tip: introduce(도입하다), destroy(파괴하다), survive(살아남다)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. (A) The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest (A)[immature / mature] acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. (B) Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the (B)[foreign / native] red squirrel populations under pressure. (C) Greys can also live more densely and in (C)[varied / uniform] habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) mature=다 자란/성숙한, (B) native=토종의, (C) varied=다양한
det.analysis:
❌ ① immature(덜 자란): 붉은 다람쥐는 '다 자란(mature)' 도토리만 소화할 수 있다고 했으므로 immature는 반대예요.

❌ ② foreign(외래의): 압박을 받은 것은 그 지역 '토종(native)' 붉은 다람쥐 개체군이므로 foreign은 문맥에 안 맞아요.

✅ ③ mature — native — varied — 원문 일치 ←정답

❌ ④ uniform(획일적인): 회색 다람쥐는 '다양한(varied)' 서식지에 산다고 했으므로 uniform은 반대예요.
det.tip: mature(다 자란), native(토종의), varied(다양한)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly ①<u>introduced</u> to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can ②<u>adapt</u> its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ③<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in ④<u>identical</u> habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ identical(동일한)은 원문 varied(다양한)의 반대로, 회색 다람쥐가 다양한 서식지에 산다는 문맥에 부적절
det.analysis:
① introduced(도입된) ✅ 적절 — 외래종이 생태계에 도입될 때 문제가 생김

② adapt(바꾸다) ✅ 적절 — 회색 다람쥐는 먹이를 바꿀 수 있어 유리함

③ competed(경쟁했다) ✅ 적절 — 두 종이 같은 먹이·서식지를 두고 경쟁함

④ identical(동일한) ❌ 부적절 — 원문은 varied(다양한). 회색 다람쥐는 '다양한' 서식지에 살아 잘 살아남았으므로 identical은 반대 ←정답
det.tip: varied(다양한) ↔ identical(동일한). 다양한 서식지 덕분에 잘 살아남음

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only ①<u>reject</u> mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ②<u>competed</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the ③<u>native</u> red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have ④<u>survived</u> more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① reject(거부하다)는 원문 digest(소화하다)의 반대로, 붉은 다람쥐가 다 자란 도토리를 소화한다는 문맥에 부적절
det.analysis:
① reject(거부하다) ❌ 부적절 — 원문은 digest(소화하다). 붉은 다람쥐는 다 자란 도토리만 '소화할' 수 있다는 문맥이라 reject는 반대 ←정답

② competed(경쟁했다) ✅ 적절 — 두 종이 같은 먹이·서식지를 두고 경쟁함

③ native(토종의) ✅ 적절 — 압박받은 것은 토종 붉은 다람쥐 개체군

④ survived(살아남았다) ✅ 적절 — 회색 다람쥐가 서식지 파괴에도 더 쉽게 살아남음
det.tip: digest(소화하다) ↔ reject(거부하다). 붉은 다람쥐는 다 자란 도토리를 소화함

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can ①<u>destroy</u> the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species ②<u>cooperated</u> for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more ③<u>densely</u> and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to ④<u>extinction</u> in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② cooperated(협력했다)는 원문 competed(경쟁했다)의 반대로, 두 종이 먹이·서식지를 두고 경쟁했다는 문맥에 부적절
det.analysis:
① destroy(파괴하다) ✅ 적절 — 회색 다람쥐가 먹이 공급을 없앰

② cooperated(협력했다) ❌ 부적절 — 원문은 competed(경쟁했다). 두 종은 같은 먹이·서식지를 두고 '경쟁했지' 협력하지 않았으므로 cooperated는 반대 ←정답

③ densely(밀집하여) ✅ 적절 — 회색 다람쥐는 더 밀집해서 삶

④ extinction(멸종) ✅ 적절 — 붉은 다람쥐가 멸종에 가까워짐
det.tip: competed(경쟁했다) ↔ cooperated(협력했다). 두 종은 서로 경쟁함

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under __________. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: put ... under pressure = ~을 압박하다. 경쟁이 토종 붉은 다람쥐 개체군을 압박했다
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: '~ which put the native red squirrel populations under ___'(그것이 토종 붉은 다람쥐 개체군을 ___에 놓았다). 경쟁으로 붉은 다람쥐가 어려움을 겪었다는 흐름이라 '압박'이 필요해요.

❌ ① control(통제): 개체군을 '통제 아래' 두었다는 뜻은 문맥과 어긋나요.

❌ ② protection(보호): 경쟁으로 붉은 다람쥐가 위협받았으므로 보호는 반대예요.

✅ ③ pressure(압박): 경쟁이 붉은 다람쥐 개체군을 압박했다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ④ care(돌봄): 경쟁·위협의 문맥과 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: put ~ under pressure = ~을 압박하다/궁지에 몰다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its __________; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: adapt its diet = 먹이(식성)를 바꾸다. 뒤에 '풋도토리를 먹을 수 있다'가 이어짐
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'The grey had the edge because it can adapt its ___; it is able ~ to eat green acorns'(회색 다람쥐는 자신의 ___을 바꿀 수 있어 유리했다; 예컨대 풋도토리도 먹을 수 있다). 뒤에 '무엇을 먹는지'가 이어지므로 '먹이·식성'이 필요해요.

❌ ① shape(모양): 무엇을 먹는지와 관련이 없어요.

❌ ② color(색깔): 먹이 이야기와 무관해요.

❌ ③ size(크기): 뒤의 '먹을 수 있다'와 연결되지 않아요.

✅ ④ diet(먹이, 식성): 풋도토리를 먹을 수 있다는 뒷내용과 딱 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: adapt one's diet = 먹이(식성)를 (상황에 맞게) 바꾸다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when __________ has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: when woodland has been destroyed = 삼림이 파괴되었을 때. 회색 다람쥐는 다양한 서식지에 살아 잘 견딤
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'Greys ~ have survived more easily when ___ has been destroyed'(회색 다람쥐는 ___이 파괴되었을 때 더 쉽게 살아남았다). 다양한 서식지에 산다는 앞 내용과 이어져 '숲·삼림'이 필요해요.

❌ ① weather(날씨): '파괴되다(destroyed)'와 어울리지 않아요.

✅ ② woodland(삼림): 숲이 파괴되어도 다양한 서식지 덕분에 살아남았다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ③ farmland(농경지): 다람쥐의 서식지는 숲이라 문맥상 어색해요.

❌ ④ population(개체군): '개체군이 파괴되면 살아남았다'는 앞뒤가 안 맞아요.
det.tip: woodland = 삼림, 숲 (다람쥐의 주요 서식지)

questions.passage: Problems often <u>arise</u> if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 arise와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: arise = 생기다, 발생하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① vanish(사라지다): 문제가 '생긴다'는 것과 반대예요.

❌ ② solve(해결하다): 문제 발생과 반대 방향이에요.

✅ ③ occur(발생하다): arise와 같은 '생기다' ←정답

❌ ④ delay(미루다): 발생과 무관해요.
det.tip: arise = occur = (문제 등이) 생기다, 발생하다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can <u>adapt</u> its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 adapt와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: adapt = 맞추어 바꾸다, 조정하다
det.analysis:
✅ ① adjust(조정하다, 맞추다): adapt와 같은 '상황에 맞게 바꾸다' ←정답

❌ ② reject(거부하다): 먹이를 '바꾼다'는 것과 반대예요.

❌ ③ ignore(무시하다): 먹이를 바꾸는 적응과 무관해요.

❌ ④ forbid(금지하다): 의미가 전혀 달라요.
det.tip: adapt = adjust = (상황에 맞게) 바꾸다, 조정하다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can <u>destroy</u> the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 destroy와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: destroy = 파괴하다, 없애다
det.analysis:
❌ ① protect(보호하다): destroy와 반대예요.

❌ ② create(만들다): 없애는 것과 반대예요.

❌ ③ repair(고치다): 파괴와 반대 방향이에요.

✅ ④ ruin(망치다, 파괴하다): destroy와 같은 '없애 버리다' ←정답
det.tip: destroy = ruin = 파괴하다, 망쳐 놓다

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 native와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: native = 토종의. 반의어: foreign(외래의)
det.analysis:
❌ ① wild(야생의): '길들여진'의 반대라 축이 달라요.

✅ ② foreign(외래의): native(토종의)의 반의어 ←정답

❌ ③ rare(드문): 희귀함과 관련된 축으로 무관해요.

❌ ④ local(그 지역의): native와 오히려 비슷한 뜻이라 반의어가 아니에요.
det.tip: native(토종의) ↔ foreign(외래의). local(그 지역의)은 오히려 유의어

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more <u>densely</u> and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 densely와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: densely = 밀집하여, 빽빽하게. 반의어: sparsely(드문드문)
det.analysis:
❌ ① closely(빽빽하게, 바짝): densely와 비슷한 뜻이라 유의어 함정이에요.

❌ ② quickly(빠르게): 속도의 축이라 밀도와 무관해요.

✅ ③ sparsely(드문드문, 성기게): densely(밀집하여)의 반의어 ←정답

❌ ④ heavily(심하게, 무겁게): 정도의 축이라 반대 뜻이 아니에요.
det.tip: densely(밀집하여) ↔ sparsely(드문드문). closely는 유의어라 함정

questions.passage:
(A) In the wild, the grey squirrel had the <u>edge</u> over the red one because it could change its diet more flexibly.

(B) She accidentally cut her finger on the sharp <u>edge</u> of the kitchen knife while cooking dinner.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 edge의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) edge = 유리함, 우위 (have the edge over ~ = ~보다 우위에 있다), (B) edge = (칼의) 날, 모서리
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 가장자리 — (B) 우위: (A)의 'had the edge over'는 '우위/유리함'이지 '가장자리'가 아니에요.

❌ ② (A) (칼의) 날 — (B) 유리함: (A)는 '유리함'이고 (B)가 '날'이라 서로 뒤바뀌었어요.

❌ ③ (A) 유리함 — (B) 경계선: (B)는 'sharp edge of the knife(칼의 날)'이지 '경계선'이 아니에요.

✅ ④ (A) 유리함, 우위 — (B) (칼의) 날, 모서리: (A) have the edge over=우위에 있다, (B) the sharp edge of the knife=칼의 날 ←정답
det.tip: edge: 우위·유리함(have the edge over) / (칼 등의) 날·모서리 — 문맥으로 구별

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the natural environment in which an animal or plant normally lives"

det.korean: habitat = 서식지 (동식물이 자연적으로 사는 환경)
det.analysis:
✅ ① habitat(서식지): 동식물이 자연적으로 사는 환경이라는 정의와 일치해요. ←정답

❌ ② ecosystem(생태계): 생물과 환경이 상호작용하는 '체계' 전체를 뜻해 정의보다 범위가 넓어요.

❌ ③ population(개체군): 특정 지역에 사는 '개체들의 무리'를 뜻해요.

❌ ④ diet(먹이, 식성): 무엇을 먹는지를 뜻해 '사는 환경'과 달라요.
det.tip: habitat = 서식지 (an animal's natural home)

questions.passage: Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to __________ (extinct) in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: extinct(형용사: 멸종한) → extinction(명사: 멸종). 'come close to + 명사' 구조로 명사가 필요
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'come close to ___(~에 가까워지다)' 뒤 명사 자리예요. 전치사 to 뒤에는 명사가 와야 하므로, 형용사 extinct(멸종한)를 명사 extinction(멸종)으로 바꿔야 해요. extinct → extinction.
det.tip: 형용사 extinct(멸종한) → 명사 extinction(멸종). come close to extinction = 멸종에 가까워지다

questions.passage: Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more __________ (easy) when woodland has been destroyed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: easy(형용사: 쉬운) → easily(부사: 쉽게). 동사 survived를 꾸미는 부사가 필요
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'have survived more ___(더 ___ 살아남았다)'로, 동사 survived(살아남다)를 꾸미는 자리예요. 동사를 꾸밀 때는 부사를 써야 하므로, 형용사 easy(쉬운)를 부사 easily(쉽게)로 바꿔야 해요. easy → easily.
det.tip: 형용사 easy(쉬운) → 부사 easily(쉽게). 동사를 꾸미면 부사

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even __________. Britain’s red and grey squirrels provide a clear example. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: have a bite = 한 입 먹다. 회색 다람쥐가 붉은 다람쥐가 먹기도 전에 먹이를 없앰
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even ___'(회색 다람쥐는 붉은 다람쥐가 ___기도 전에 먹이 공급을 없앨 수 있다). 먹이가 사라진다는 문맥이라 '먹다'가 필요해요.

❌ ① run away(도망치다): 먹이 공급 이야기와 관련이 없어요.

❌ ② take a rest(쉬다): 먹이를 먹는 문맥과 어긋나요.

✅ ③ have a bite(한 입 먹다): 붉은 다람쥐가 먹어 보기도 전에 먹이가 사라진다는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ④ make a sound(소리를 내다): 먹이 경쟁과 무관해요.
det.tip: have a bite = 한 입 먹다 (먹이를 조금이라도 먹다)

questions.passage: Problems often arise if an exotic species is suddenly introduced to an ecosystem. The grey had the edge because it can adapt its diet; it is able, for instance, to eat green acorns, while the red can only digest mature acorns. Within the same area of forest, grey squirrels can destroy the food supply before red squirrels even have a bite. Britain’s red and grey squirrels __________. When the grey arrived from America in the 1870s, both squirrel species competed for the same food and habitat, which put the native red squirrel populations under pressure. Greys can also live more densely and in varied habitats, so have survived more easily when woodland has been destroyed. As a result, the red squirrel has come close to extinction in England.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: provide a clear example = 분명한 예를 보여 주다. 영국의 다람쥐가 앞서 말한 문제의 실례
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'Britain's red and grey squirrels ___'(영국의 붉은·회색 다람쥐가 ___). 앞에서 '외래종 도입으로 문제가 생긴다'고 했고, 이어 영국 다람쥐 사례를 설명하므로 '분명한 예를 보여 준다'가 필요해요.

❌ ① ignore the warning(경고를 무시하다): 사례를 드는 흐름과 관련이 없어요.

✅ ② provide a clear example(분명한 예를 보여 주다): 도입부 문제의 실례로 영국 다람쥐를 제시하는 흐름에 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ③ avoid the danger(위험을 피하다): 뒤에 위협받는 이야기가 나오므로 반대예요.

❌ ④ cause a mistake(실수를 유발하다): 문맥과 무관해요.
det.tip: provide a clear example = 분명한 사례를 보여 주다
